def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    if not car_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Sort cars by their horizontal center
    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Find the main road
    road_patches = image_patch.find("road")
    if not road_patches: return car_patches
    
    # Get the rightmost point of the road
    rightmost_road_edge = max(r.right for r in road_patches)
    
    # Filter cars that are on the right side of the road
    right_car_patches = [car for car in car_patches if car.right > rightmost_road_edge]
    
    return right_car_patches
